schema.name: db_metadata
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE db_metadata (
    key   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: food_aliases
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE food_aliases (
    id         INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    food_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    alias      TEXT    NOT NULL,
    alias_norm TEXT    NOT NULL,
    lang       TEXT    NOT NULL,              -- es | en
    FOREIGN KEY (food_id) REFERENCES foods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

schema.name: food_categories
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE food_categories (
    id         INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    key        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name_es    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name_en    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    icon_key   TEXT    NOT NULL,
    color_hex  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL
)

schema.name: food_macros
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE food_macros (
    food_id        INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    kcal           REAL    NOT NULL,
    kj             REAL    NOT NULL,
    protein_g      REAL    NOT NULL,
    fat_g          REAL    NOT NULL,
    carbs_g        REAL    NOT NULL,
    carbs_total_g  REAL    NOT NULL,
    fiber_g        REAL    NOT NULL,
    alcohol_g      REAL    NOT NULL,
    sugars_g       REAL,
    starch_g       REAL,
    sat_fat_g      REAL,
    mono_fat_g     REAL,
    poly_fat_g     REAL,
    trans_fat_g    REAL,
    cholesterol_mg REAL,
    water_g        REAL,
    sodium_mg      REAL,
    salt_g         REAL,
    potassium_mg   REAL,
    calcium_mg     REAL,
    magnesium_mg   REAL,
    phosphorus_mg  REAL,
    iron_mg        REAL,
    zinc_mg        REAL,
    iodine_ug      REAL,
    selenium_ug    REAL,
    vit_a_ug       REAL,
    vit_c_mg       REAL,
    vit_d_ug       REAL,
    vit_e_mg       REAL,
    vit_b6_mg      REAL,
    vit_b12_ug     REAL,
    folate_ug      REAL,
    energy_source  TEXT    NOT NULL,          -- REPORTED | ATWATER
    mass_balance_g REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (food_id) REFERENCES foods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

schema.name: food_nutrients
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE food_nutrients (
    food_id         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tag             TEXT    NOT NULL,
    value           REAL    NOT NULL,
    value_type      TEXT,                     -- BEDCA code: AR|BE|LZ|MN|AV|...
    is_logical_zero INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (food_id, tag),
    FOREIGN KEY (food_id) REFERENCES foods(id)         ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag)     REFERENCES nutrient_defs(tag)
)

schema.name: food_portions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE food_portions (
    id           INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    food_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label_es     TEXT    NOT NULL,
    label_en     TEXT    NOT NULL,
    grams        REAL    NOT NULL,
    portion_type TEXT    NOT NULL,            -- UNIT|SLICE|CUP|TBSP|TSP|PINCH|
                                              -- HANDFUL|PORTION|GLASS|CAN|BOTTLE|SPLASH
    is_default   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    source       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NUTRINEST',
    FOREIGN KEY (food_id) REFERENCES foods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

schema.name: food_quality_issues
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE food_quality_issues (
    id       INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    food_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    code     TEXT    NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT    NOT NULL,                -- INFO | WARN | ERROR
    detail   TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (food_id) REFERENCES foods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

schema.name: foods
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE foods (
    id               INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    name_es          TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name_en          TEXT,
    name_norm        TEXT    NOT NULL,        -- lowercase, accent-stripped
    base_name_es     TEXT    NOT NULL,        -- name minus preparation state
    base_name_norm   TEXT    NOT NULL,
    prep_state       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNSPECIFIED',
    category_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    aisle_id         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    source           TEXT    NOT NULL,
    source_ref       TEXT,
    langual          TEXT,
    is_liquid        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    density_g_ml     REAL,                    -- null => no volume conversion
    completeness_pct INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    quality          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OK',   -- OK|SUSPECT|INCOMPLETE
    is_deprecated    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    replaced_by_id   INTEGER,
    updated_at       INTEGER NOT NULL, name_en_norm TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', raw_safety TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id)    REFERENCES food_categories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aisle_id)       REFERENCES shopping_aisles(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (replaced_by_id) REFERENCES foods(id)
)

schema.name: nutrient_defs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE nutrient_defs (
    tag            TEXT    NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    name_es        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name_en        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    unit           TEXT    NOT NULL,          -- g | mg | ug | kcal
    nutrient_group TEXT    NOT NULL,          -- ENERGY|MACRO|SUGAR|FAT|FATTY_ACID|MINERAL|VITAMIN
    is_primary     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    sort_order     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    nrv            REAL                       -- EU Reg. 1169/2011 daily reference
)

schema.name: shopping_aisles
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shopping_aisles (
    id         INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    key        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name_es    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name_en    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL
)
